verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's docs describe connecting to market-leading partner tools across AI code generation, security, testing and monitoring. They also show in-product installation of a third-party integration (Snyk via the repository Security tab), so the product does support installing third-party integrations. However, no marketplace or app directory is explicitly named, and the only concrete install flow shown is Snyk. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browsable marketplace/app directory, an install flow that applies beyond Snyk, breadth of the listed apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
